versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the allocated baseline is established and under configuration control to preclude unauthorized changes. Standard: The allocated baseline is properly documented, approved and brought under control by a Configuration Management Process. Method of Compliance: The Configuration Management Plan is defined and implemented in accordance with the contract. Inspection of documentation verifies that the allocated baseline has been documented and approved. Inspection of the engineering release documentation verifies adequate capture of the allocated baseline. References: MIL-HDBK-61 5.5 Configuration Baselines; 6 Configuration Control MIL-STD-961, Appendix A NAVAIRINST 4130.1
